The '''Cedrian Terrace''' was a multistory restaurant located on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. It was a maze of tables, diners and booths.

[[BV-1210]] was one of the [[Service droid/Legends|serving droids]] that worked as waiters in the establishment. It was packaged with spy equipment to record conversations in the restaurant and relay then to the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]].

The Cedrian Terrace was a regular meeting place of at least one group of [[Spy/Legends|spies]] from competing interests. These included [[Sharalon]], an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent; [[Drixar]], whose employer was unknown, but may have been the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]; [[Garin]], a possible agent for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The three used to meet every week at a usual table in a booth by a window.
